title: A CVICU Romance in the Blizzard
summary: On Tuesday, February 10, 2015, a historic blizzard shuts down Southwest Virginia, trapping Zoë with Jordan at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke while keeping Kelsey, Isabel, and Garrett snowbound in Blacksburg. After Zoë talks Jordan through a post-op CPAP crisis, Jordan confides to Zoë in the room and Aubrie Jean on video chat about his feelings for Isabel and the Florence Nightingale Effect—learning that Isabel would be warmly welcomed into the No-Jealousy Pact once she is no longer their RA.
